scope: Formatting guideline and graph_core C/H formatting; equivalent guard-clause rewrites in 13 functions. Legacy code, external dependencies, existing tests and historical verification evidence were not reformatted.
baseline: Dirty working tree captured immediately before this task; includes the completed simplification and clock relocation. This is not Git HEAD.

policy.rules: 4 spaces, 100-column target, Linux brace placement, no single-line control bodies, preserve include order/string literals/comments, semantic blank lines, early guards only when cleanup and evaluation order are preserved.

invariants: Guard conditions retain left-to-right short-circuit evaluation.
Admission release retains validation-before-mutation passes and notification order.
Closing endpoints do not enter preparation; unsuccessful uncharge retains ownership.
Node INIT is consumed before eligibility checking, as before.
Host inactive artifact path still locks/unlocks without reading the clock.
Worker lock scopes, entry checks, cleanup tails, deadlines and two bounded edge/node passes retain their order.
review.limit: Lexical comparison ignores comments/whitespace and is a review aid; it is not formal behavioral equivalence verification.

runtime_process.command: env KAOS_P3_HOST=/tmp/kaos-timing-host/core/kaos_host KAOS_P3_GUEST=/tmp/kaos-timing-host/node.wasm ASAN_OPTIONS=detect_stack_use_after_return=0 uv --directory ../sim_env run --offline python -m unittest discover -s tests -p test_graph_runtime_process.py -v

results.inner_skips: Default Python discovery retains 41 opt-in skips among 171 entries; the smaller profile skips its three-node local pipeline. The nine explicit runtime cases have no skips.

codegen.method: Compile each of 18 native translation units before/after with the configured include/define flags, -O2 -g0, sanitizers removed, stdin source and normalized file-prefix mapping; repeat for default/four profiles.
codegen.differences: The five files containing control-flow edits differ in both profiles. The other thirteen native translation units produce byte-identical objects in both profiles.
codegen.limit: Compiler comparison is additional evidence for unchanged formatting-only translation units; neither code size nor timing equivalence is claimed for guard rewrites.

existing_verification_sources.result: Every baseline C/H/Python file under verification remains byte-identical, including saved harnesses. No existing test or assertion changed.

evidence.review_patches: *.review.patch strip blank lines/indentation to expose the five control-flow diffs; review with full source for scopes.

limitations: Regression checks and source review support behavior preservation but are not exhaustive proof. No physical target stack, timing or throughput qualification was performed. Application-CoAP/manifest design remains unchanged.
environment: Host tests used authorized socket/sanitizer access outside the sandbox. Builds needed the generated WAMR version header in the sibling dependency directory.
